title: The all-returned bank configuration is fixed
statement: Let $l\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and consider any configuration of the $l$-counter bank whose control at every component is the return state. One step of the bank leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: every component control is the return state
replaced: Every configuration of the counter bank whose control has all components in the return state is left entirely unchanged by one step of the bank.
